lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pae satigur saranaa ||
lines.translation: Seeing this world on fire, I rushed to the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਰਹਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sach diRaaiaa sadaa sach sa(n)jam rahanaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has implanted the Truth within me; I dwell steadfastly in Truth and self-restraint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚਾ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਸਬਦੇ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sachaa hai bohithaa sabade bhavajal taranaa ||6||
lines.translation: The True Guru is the Boat of Truth; in the Word of the Shabad, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਫਿਰਦੇ ਰਹੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh chauraaseeh phirade rahe bin satigur mukat na hoee ||
lines.translation: People continue wandering through the cycle of 8.4 million incarnations; without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR paR pa(n)dit monee thake doojai bhaai pat khoee ||
lines.translation: Reading and studying, the Pandits and the silent sages have grown weary, but attached to the love of duality, they have lost their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sabad sunaaiaa bin sache avar na koee ||7||
lines.translation: The True Guru teaches the Word of the Shabad; without the True One, there is no other at all. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚੈ ਲਾਏ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਗੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sachai laae se sach lage nit sachee kaar kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who are linked by the True One are linked to Truth. They always act in Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਮਹਲਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa nij ghar vaasaa paaiaa sachai mahal raha(n)n ||
lines.translation: They attain their dwelling in the home of their own inner being, and they abide in the Mansion of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥੮॥੧੭॥੮॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhagat sukheee sadaa sachai naam racha(n)n ||8||17||8||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the devotees are happy and peaceful forever. They are absorbed in the True Name. ||8||17||8||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੁਸਕਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਣੈ ਢੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau musakal at banai dhoee koi na dei ||
lines.translation: When you are confronted with terrible hardships, and no one offers you any support,

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਸਮਨਾ ਸਾਕ ਭਿ ਭਜਿ ਖਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: laagoo hoe dusamanaa saak bh bhaj khale ||
lines.translation: when your friends turn into enemies, and even your relatives have deserted you,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੋ ਭਜੈ ਆਸਰਾ ਚੁਕੈ ਸਭੁ ਅਸਰਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabho bhajai aasaraa chukai sabh asaraau ||
lines.translation: and when all support has given way, and all hope has been lost

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham lagai na tatee vaau ||1||
lines.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, even the hot wind shall not touch you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਨਿਤਾਣਿਆ ਕਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib nitaaniaa kaa taan ||
lines.translation: Our Lord and Master is the Power of the powerless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai na jaaee thir sadaa gurasabadee sach jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He does not come or go; He is Eternal and Permanent. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is known as True. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੁਬਲਾ ਨੰਗ ਭੁਖ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ko hovai dubalaa na(n)g bhukh kee peer ||
lines.translation: If you are weakened by the pains of hunger and poverty,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਮੜਾ ਪਲੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਧੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: damaRaa palai naa pavai naa ko devai dheer ||
lines.translation: with no money in your pockets, and no one will give you any comfort,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਆਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: suaarath suaau na ko kare naa kichh hovai kaaj ||
lines.translation: and no one will satisfy your hopes and desires, and none of your works is accomplished

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਜੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nihachal hovai raaj ||2||
lines.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall obtain the eternal kingdom. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਦੇਹੀ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau chi(n)taa bahut bahut dehee viaapai rog ||
lines.translation: When you are plagued by great and excessive anxiety, and diseases of the body;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਸਤਿ ਕੁਟੰਬਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹਰਖੁ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: grisat kuta(n)b paletiaa kade harakh kade sog ||
lines.translation: when you are wrapped up in the attachments of household and family, sometimes feeling joy, and then other times sorrow;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaun kare chahu ku(n)t kaa ghaRee na baisan soi ||
lines.translation: when you are wandering around in all four directions, and you cannot sit or sleep even for a moment

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham tan man seetal hoi ||3||
lines.translation: -if you come to remember the Supreme Lord God, then your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮਿ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਲੋਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam karodh mohi vas keeaa kirapan lobh piaar ||
lines.translation: When you are under the power of sexual desire, anger and worldly attachment, or a greedy miser in love with your wealth;

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਉਨਿ ਅਘ ਕੀਏ ਹੋਆ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare kilavikh un agh keee hoaa asur sa(n)ghaar ||
lines.translation: if you have committed the four great sins and other mistakes; even if you are a murderous fiend

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੋਥੀ ਗੀਤ ਕਵਿਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਕਰਨਿ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: pothee geet kavit kichh kade na karan dhariaa ||
lines.translation: who has never taken the time to listen to sacred books, hymns and poetry

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਓਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: chit aavai os paarabraham taa nimakh simarat tariaa ||4||
lines.translation: -if you then come to remember the Supreme Lord God, and contemplate Him, even for a moment, you shall be saved. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਖਾਗਰ ਬਿਚਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saasat si(n)mrit bed chaar mukhaagar bichare ||
lines.translation: People may recite by heart the Shaastras, the Simritees and the four Vedas;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tape tapeesar jogeeaa teerath gavan kare ||
lines.translation: they may be ascetics, great, self-disciplined Yogis; they may visit sacred shrines of pilgrimage

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਗੁਣੇ ਪੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khat karamaa te dugune poojaa karataa naai ||
lines.translation: and perform the six ceremonial rituals, over and over again, performing worship services and ritual bathings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਨਰਕੇ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g na lagee paarabraham taa sarapar narake jaai ||5||
lines.translation: Even so, if they have not embraced love for the Supreme Lord God, then they shall surely go to hell. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਕ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj milak sikadaareeaa ras bhogan bisathaar ||
lines.translation: You may possess empires, vast estates, authority over others, and the enjoyment of myriads of pleasures;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਗ ਸੁਹਾਵੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਚਲੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: baag suhaave sohane chalai hukam aphaar ||
lines.translation: you may have delightful and beautiful gardens, and issue unquestioned commands;

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗ ਤਮਾਸੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਚਾਇ ਲਗਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g tamaase bahu bidhee chaai lag rahiaa ||
lines.translation: you may have enjoyments and entertainments of all sorts and kinds, and continue to enjoy exciting pleasures

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਾ ਸਰਪ ਕੀ ਜੂਨਿ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: chit na aaio paarabraham taa sarap kee joon gaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: -and yet, if you do not come to remember the Supreme Lord God, you shall be reincarnated as a snake. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਧਨਾਢਿ ਅਚਾਰਵੰਤੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut dhanaadh achaarava(n)t sobhaa niramal reet ||
lines.translation: You may possess vast riches, maintain virtuous conduct, have a spotless reputation and observe religious customs;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭਾਈਆ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maat pitaa sut bhaaeeaa saajan sa(n)g pareet ||
lines.translation: you may have the loving affections of mother, father, children, siblings and friends;

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਸਕਰ ਤਰਕਸਬੰਦ ਬੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਕੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: lasakar tarakasaba(n)d ba(n)d jeeu jeeu sagalee keet ||
lines.translation: you may have armies well-equipped with weapons, and all may salute you with respect;
